_doc: Rules of graph.extract.cfg (YAML k8s, Helm, CI, Ansible; HCL). ansible: path_modules = task keys whose value (a path, or a mapping / `file=x` string with one of path_params) is a task or vars file read relative to the including file, src_modules = modules whose `src` is a template or file looked up in the tree, role_keys = include_role / import_role (name), list_keys = lists of paths (vars_files). make / just / nginx: the data of graph.extract.cfgts (make.special = special targets that are no recipes, phony = the declaration of commands, goal = the variable of the default goal, file_funcs = functions whose result is files, never recipes (a prerequisite `$(wildcard src/*.c)` makes no dynamic site), public = conventional recipe names that are soft roots; just.private_attrs, mod_files = the files a `mod`/`import` may name, {p} the written path; jinja2.builtins = names that are called but are no macro; nginx.include = the directives that include a file, file_directives = regex of the directives that name a code file of the tree: root, alias and ssl_certificate are no code). (the build tools that CI, shell and docs lines run: data build_tools of frameworks.json, graph.roots.build_targets.) k8s: named_kinds = any mapping {kind: <one of them>, name} is a reference (Flux valuesFrom, a PVC dataSource ...); annotation_refs = metadata.annotations keys (after the last '/') whose value names an object ('ns/name' or 'name'; ingress-nginx); workloads and every kind not listed under consumed/soft_roots are hard roots; consumed kinds are dead without a reader; soft_roots are weak-alive. refs: a key whose value is a mapping (or a sequence of mappings) names an object through `field` (of kind `kind`, '*' = the mapping's own `kind` field); without `field` the key's scalar value is the name. skip: keys whose children are user data, never entered. reader_labels: regex of the label keys by which a controller reads a ConfigMap, Secret or Role (RBAC aggregation, the Grafana sidecar, Argo CD repository secrets): the object is a soft root. dir_refs: a GitOps object (Flux Kustomization, Argo Application) deploys a directory of the tree (dotted path of the field, a sequence is walked). exec_tokens: one capture group, a script path (also behind a $VAR, ${VAR} or ${{ }} prefix); the script an interpreter runs and a python -m module come from the command parser of graph.roots (data frameworks.json interpreters), not from this list. exec_keys: keys of a k8s object or of a YAML file that GitHub Actions and GitLab CI do not own (compose, Ansible, pre-commit, Travis, CircleCI, Azure Pipelines, Taskfile ...) whose value is a command line or an argv list. gha.entry_keys: files of the action directory; gha.container_keys: paths inside the image (the basename is looked up in the tree). helm.file_refs: regexes whose group is a file a template reads; helm.chart_files: names (globs) next to a Chart.yaml that helm reads with no template naming them, include refs of the chart. kustomize: kinds (or, without a kind, marker_keys) of a kustomization; path_keys name the files it builds, path_fields hold them inside a list of mappings. loki.rule_dirs: dotted paths in a plain mapping (a Loki config) whose value is a directory of rule files that a ruler reads (include of `dir/**`). gitlab.root: the root of a GitLab CI file that is not the pipeline by its name. terraform: native_blocks = the block types of Terraform (any other top-level block is another HCL tool: the file is read from outside), file_funcs = functions whose first string argument is a file of the tree, path_prefix = the part of that string that is the directory of the .tf file.
